question: Compare geometric, square-root and arithmetic proximal targets before attributing variance or training gains to interpolation geometry
theory: Generalize TOP-D's variance bound to sharp shape-dependent moment orders and distinguish normalized signal scale
Construct a teacher-preserving Markov kernel for exact power-mean updates to prove all convex-generator divergences decrease
Bridge reverse-KL inner fitting errors to true teacher reverse-KL improvement using range and Renyi bounds
Characterize the locally steepest shape for a specified teacher divergence at equal Fisher displacement
Use score-weighted variance-optimal baselines to distinguish shape effects from baseline effects

resources.priority: After current online-opd-bf16-lr5em7-s42 training worker completes; before remaining original arms
resources.vocabulary: tokenizer-supported complete vocabulary, not padded HF columns

cached_model_audit.normalization: Report raw f and f/lambda; do not equate prefix heterogeneity with conditional variance
cached_model_audit.matched_displacement: Compare target paths at the same mean squared Fisher-Rao radius, using the geometric lambda=0.1 radius as the reference
cached_model_audit.uncertainty: Bootstrap response clusters, not individual correlated prefix positions

gpu_canaries.precision: fp32 master weights with bf16 native forward
gpu_canaries.acceptance: Four registered GPU owners, finite losses and gradients, native anchor sync KL below 1e-5, checkpoint readable

full_parameter_gradient_probe.reference: Exact full-vocabulary backward before any optimizer update
full_parameter_gradient_probe.precision_note: Compare actual bf16-forward arithmetic; finite draws do not certify unbiasedness

protocol_controls: square-root target with exact BPO/anchor actions

gpu_fixed_prefix_training.loss_scale: Divide each target-fitting objective by lambda, including kappa=0
gpu_fixed_prefix_training.action_sampling: Fresh iid anchor actions each inner update; shared action seeds across shapes

matched_radius_controls.calibration: Exact 256-prefix training panel, excluding heldout responses

gpu_fixed_prefix_training.fits_and_proposals: Common reverse KL, exact BPO residual, and independently selected Hellinger fitting; anchor and current-student categorical action proposals are separate controls
gpu_fixed_prefix_training.theory_selected_target: Unique minimizer of sharp worst-case Fisher velocity: 0.44192837352858505; compare reverse-KL and Hellinger fits

math_evaluation.conditions: initial model and final common reverse-KL kappa=0,0.5,1 at lambda=0.1
math_evaluation.limits: Single-prompt fixed-prefix pilot; final mathematical accuracy is exploratory, not a general-distillation benchmark

success_conditions: Mathematical identities pass finite-difference, random-distribution and adversarial-tail checks before GPU jobs are enabled
All large-model distributions satisfy the asserted uniform upper bounds within numerical tolerance
Primary empirical shape hypothesis is assessed from paired cluster statistics and equal-displacement controls
Only finite, auditable canaries permit the full pilot matrix
Record negative or inconclusive comparisons rather than selecting a checkpoint after seeing accuracy
rejection_conditions: A mathematical counterexample invalidates the corresponding theorem regardless of average experimental results
Failure of cached-distribution normalization or native model anchor sync blocks the affected training comparison
If square-root variance or heldout teacher improvement is worse, reject universal empirical superiority while retaining valid mathematical bounds
An OOM, nonfinite gradient or GPU ownership conflict stops the owned attempt without using GPUs 4-7
variable_choices: This is a preregistered MVP; broader prompt coverage and larger model pairs follow evidence from this pilot
Canary failure may change memory settings, with the amendment recorded before restarting
No advantage standardization, suffix-return changes or PPO clipping are introduced into the target-geometry comparison

amendments.reason: Radius calibration on 128 random prefixes did not transfer to all 4096 prefixes; use the exact training panel for GPU radius controls. Diagnostic calibration remains preserved as evidence.

Sharp self-bounding noise constant applies to inner fitting shape, not target shape; separate these choices and retain BPO as a residual-feedback control. Add the analytically derived minimax target as a pre-training control.
